answer: Agents secure 1,000 units of access via an inlet where each agent must present a proof to validate state at a vertex. Admission gating uses this inlet to monitor flow, while the vertex serves as the anchor point verification. If a relic is found, the revocation check triggers. Honest agents pay one unit; malicious farms creating 1,000 fake identities fail as the relic penalty triggers immediate nullification, locking access for 100 days.
